title: wait-ask-deadline-slot: Fix wait_ask to carry real deadline_slot (was vb-r4fix-001)
description: Bug P0-6 (regression fix; was previously filed as vb-r4fix-001). vb_runtime/src/primitives/wait_ask.rs:14-24 (wait_until) and :31-46 (wait_event) emit `AwaitingWait { deadline_slot: SlotIdx::new(0) }` instead of the actual deadline_slot from the WaitUntil/WaitEvent IR node. The chain is: engine/execute.rs:176 → engine/handlers.rs:329-336 → wait_ask::wait_until(run, deadline_slot) → AwaitingWait { deadline_slot: SlotIdx::new(0) } → engine/signal.rs:34 → shard/lifecycle/chunk_002.rs:219-224 → shard/transitions.rs:161 → compute_deadline_ms_from_slot (line 215-240) reads slot 0 (which is wrong; it should read the slot the user passed). The bug means every WaitUntil schedules its timer at the deadline stored in slot 0, not the deadline the workflow author specified. Master §45 WaitUntil semantics require: Inputs read = `deadline_slot` (must be I64 or F64); Suspension = Returns `AwaitingWait`. Master §68 invariant 4: Recovery is deterministic — wrong deadline breaks the deterministic guarantee. This bead changes the two `SlotIdx::new(0)` literals to the actual `deadline_slot` parameter.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve the WaitUntil node's deadline_slot value in the AwaitingWait signal, not coerce it to SlotIdx::new(0)
THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve the WaitEvent node's timeout_slot value in the AwaitingWait signal, not coerce it to SlotIdx::new(0)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a WaitUntil node is executed with deadline_slot = SlotIdx(5)
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit AwaitingWait { deadline_slot: SlotIdx(5) }

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a WaitEvent node is executed with timeout_slot = Some(SlotIdx(7))
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit AwaitingWait { deadline_slot: SlotIdx(7) }

unwanted.condition: IF a WaitUntil node's deadline_slot is unbound (slot was never written)
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently default to slot 0; it must return SlotOutOfBounds before emitting AwaitingWait
unwanted.because: Master §45: Inputs read = deadline_slot (must be I64 or F64); an unbound slot is a typed error, not a default-to-zero

preconditions: WaitUntil node's deadline_slot is a valid SlotIdx (in range [0, slot_count))
Slot at deadline_slot has been written and contains a numeric value (I64 or F64) per master §45
postconditions: AwaitingWait signal carries the original deadline_slot value, not SlotIdx::new(0)
compute_deadline_ms_from_slot reads the same slot the workflow author wrote
invariants: Two workflows with different deadline_slot values produce two distinct AwaitingWait signals with distinct deadline_slot fields
Replay reconstructs the same AwaitingWait with the same deadline_slot (master §68.4 deterministic recovery)

happy: wait_until_carries_real_deadline_slot: run a workflow with WaitUntil { deadline_slot: SlotIdx(5) } where slot 5 = 1000ms; the AwaitingWait signal has deadline_slot = SlotIdx(5), not SlotIdx(0)
wait_event_carries_real_timeout_slot: run a workflow with WaitEvent { timeout_slot: Some(SlotIdx(7)) } where slot 7 = 5000ms; the AwaitingWait signal has deadline_slot = SlotIdx(7)
error: wait_until_with_unbound_deadline_slot_returns_slot_out_of_bounds: a workflow where deadline_slot points to an unwritten slot returns SlotOutOfBounds, not a silent AwaitingWait with deadline_slot=0
wait_event_with_unbound_timeout_slot_returns_slot_out_of_bounds: a WaitEvent node whose timeout_slot points to an unwritten slot returns SlotOutOfBounds
wait_until_with_non_numeric_deadline_returns_type_mismatch: a WaitUntil node whose deadline_slot holds a Symbol value returns TypeMismatch { expected: 'deadline' }
edge: kani_harness_proves_deadline_slot_preserved: 100 random WaitUntil nodes, assert AwaitingWait.deadline_slot matches the input

files: crates/vb_runtime/src/primitives/wait_ask.rs:14-24 (wait_until; the bug is on the Ok(...) arm)
crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/signal.rs:34 (where AwaitingWait is materialized into the signal)
patterns: Pattern: existing primitives (Copy, EvalExpr) carry the slot index forward correctly; this is an isolated bug in wait_ask.rs only
questions: Was there a previous fix attempt (vb-r4fix-001) that introduced the SlotIdx::new(0) placeholder? (Spec: yes, but the placeholder was never replaced with the parameter.)

security_failures.failure: Attacker writes a workflow that exploits the SlotIdx::new(0) bug to time-of-check vs time-of-use, evading rate limits
security_failures.prevention: Fix the bug; deadline_slot is honored, so rate-limit checks use the real deadline
security_failures.test_for_it: wait_until_rate_limit_uses_real_deadline (assert timer fires at the slot value, not slot 0)

usability_failures.failure: Workflow author writes a 30-second WaitUntil but it actually waits for the value in slot 0 (often 0ms = immediate)
usability_failures.prevention: Fix the bug; the real deadline_slot is honored

data_integrity_failures.failure: Recovery reads a journal entry with AwaitingWait { deadline_slot: 5 } and rebuilds the timer for slot 0 (wrong)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Fix the bug; the deadline_slot field is correct in the journal, so recovery reads the right slot

integration_failures.failure: Timer scheduler in shard subscribes to slot 0 changes but the actual deadline lives in slot 5
integration_failures.prevention: Fix the bug; shard/scheduler uses the correct slot
integration_failures.test_for_it: scheduler_subscribes_to_real_deadline_slot (assert timer fires when slot N changes, not slot 0)

phase_0: Read crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/execute.rs:176 to confirm deadline_slot is passed as a parameter
Read crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/handlers.rs:329-336 to confirm the parameter is forwarded
phase_1: Write Kani harness test_wait_until_deadline_slot_preserved (100 unwind, Arbitrary SlotIdx)
phase_2: In wait_ask.rs:14-24 wait_until: change `Ok(vb_core::EngineSignal::AwaitingWait { deadline_slot: vb_core::ids::SlotIdx::new(0) })` to `Ok(vb_core::EngineSignal::AwaitingWait { deadline_slot })`
In wait_ask.rs:31-46 wait_event: same change with timeout_slot.unwrap_or(deadline_slot_fallback) — but the function signature already has a deadline_slot parameter; just forward it
phase_3: Verify compute_deadline_ms_from_slot (shard/transitions.rs:215-240) now reads the correct slot
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_runtime` and verify all new tests pass
Run `cargo kani -p vb_runtime --harness wait_until_deadline_slot_preserved` and verify the proof
Manual: a workflow with `wait_until: { deadline: $future_at_unix_ms_plus_30s }` should wait 30s, not 0s

similar_implementations: Other primitives (Copy, EvalExpr, BuildObject) carry the slot index correctly; pattern to copy

key_sections_to_understand: The function signature of wait_until and wait_event

apis_that_do_not_exist: There is no `deadline_slot_or_default()` helper; just use the parameter directly
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT use SlotIdx::new(0) as a default for any deadline; the deadline is always the parameter
